digest.component_or_area: Backend port / reconciler vendor adapter interface
propositions: Four core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) directly import adapters.jira for scalar concerns (project scoping, environment validation, exception handling) that should be mediated through the Backend protocol

The Backend protocol must expose scalar, read-only members (project, query_project, assert_env_ready) and neutral exception types to eliminate vendor-specific imports from core modules while preserving existing fail-fast and fail-closed semantics
Full-tree AST analysis is required to detect lazy imports of adapters.jira at any nesting depth (function-level) in the four target modules, not just module-level imports

JiraBackend must implement the new protocol members by delegating to resolve_jira_settings, and all existing Backend implementors (S2 contract suite, FakeBackend) must satisfy the widened structural protocol
